authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13551 sūcī gives sūī/suĩ/sūw needle with northern diphthong and glide variants. These svī̃ responses fit the non-nasal-cluster first branch, not the distinct *sūñcī branch. Reviewed comparator: Buksa sui “needle” (f_6ibsjwjglgtr4). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6983 nava gives northern nāwu/nā̃o and regional no/nūā new, including feminine naī. These simple n-vowel forms fit that family; source diphthongs and nasalization are preserved. Reviewed comparator: bundeli_atarra nãū “new” (f_zidthvuhkxtte). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
